description: A full architectural overhaul introducing a faster, more modular TypeScript-driven system. This release improves metadata loading, strengthens multi-season navigation, and makes the platform more scalable as content libraries grow.

logs.desc: 'infoHandler.ts' and 'playlistHandler.ts' migrated to the new modular architecture for significantly faster execution.
A high-performance season switcher for both Info and Watch pages, supporting complex multi-season content structures.
The new 'listAnime.ts' core engine for anime listings, season redirects, and dynamic video button generation with TypeScript-driven efficiency.
Fail-safe metadata fallbacks, such as 'Unknown Uploader' and 'Unknown Studio', to prevent UI breakage when metadata is missing.
Previous and Next navigation buttons for content listers, making browsing more streamlined.
Turkish localization support for the footer component.
[BETA] tags on the Discover and Featured pages to indicate ongoing performance optimization work.
Timestamp precision on information pages to include hours and seconds for more accurate duration display.
'gridVideoButton' so episode numbers remain visible, durations are hidden on smaller screens, and descriptions appear on hover for a cleaner UI.
Video player control buttons and the Anime Card architecture for a more polished, modern look.
The footer layout to be fully responsive across all device sizes.
Incorrect routing in the footer's company links.
Automatic collapsing on the Update Log page to improve readability and scannability.
Redundant text from the navbar settings link for a cleaner, more minimal appearance.
The 'Go To' navigation feature on the What's New page is currently unresponsive.
